page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine deployed via KVM virtualization. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Its compute configuration provides 8 dedicated vCPUs running across 4 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, paired with 32 GB of system memory to form a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, BMI2, and AES-NI. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence, and provides a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without integrated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.sn2.xlarge within the modest-performance tier for dedicated cloud hardware. Single-core metrics, including a Geekbench score of 848.0 and a stress-ng score of 1105.29, place processing power in the lower brackets. Multi-core performance reflects a similar baseline, achieving 3291.0 in Geekbench and 5834.87 in stress-ng. Passmark CPU testing demonstrates intermediate capability with an overall CPU score of 6995.67 and extended instruction performance of 6054.5. Large-block uncached memory write throughput registers at a stable 33.29 GB/sec, while static web serving achieves 3.58 GB/sec and Redis SET operations handle 5.54 million operations per second.

The hardware configuration provides predictable resource isolation via dedicated core assignment, though the modest clock frequency and low compression scores constrain heavy compute pipelines. Because local storage is absent, throughput depends heavily on remote block storage performance over the 2 Gbps network baseline. The ecs.sn2.xlarge is best matched with general business infrastructure, including application middle-tiers, internal tools, lightweight database instances, staging servers, and background workers with balanced memory footprints.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32 GB of RAM powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. Designed around a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio across 4 physical cores, the instance includes AVX-512 support but omits bundled local storage, requiring reliance on attached network storage. Benchmark evaluations indicate entry-tier compute capabilities, with Geekbench single-core scores of 848.0 and multi-core scores of 3291.0 falling into the lower percentiles, complemented by steady mid-range performance in Passmark CPU tests (6995.67). Network throughput offers a 2 Gbps baseline without integrated GPU hardware. The instance provides steady, dedicated resources suitable for moderate web serving, utility application tiers, continuous integration workers, and light database or in-memory caching workloads where extreme single-thread performance is not required.
